$comment: The dependency register: one assessment per direct dependency per manifest, against the six criteria in docs/dependency-criteria.md in linked-data-explorer (sgort/linked-data-explorer#250). Read by scripts/dependency-gate.mjs in the lockfile-review job, which fails a pull request that adds a direct dependency without an entry here, or with an entry the registry evidence contradicts; and by scripts/dependency-review.mjs, which lists open overrides and replacements every quarter. The first entry was assessed after the fact on 28 November 2026.

maintained.why: The package is maintained (26.2.5 on 27 October 2026, four releases in the last year), but the locked 23.x line is frozen: 23.0.7 of 22 February 2024 is its last release and gets no fixes.

releasePolicy.why: Neither 23.0.7 nor the latest release carries npm provenance, and we run a major the project no longer supports; a security policy exists only in keycloak/.github.

footprint.why: Three transitive packages, each used by keycloak-js alone in this tree: jwt-decode, js-sha256 and base64-js, all MIT.

needed.why: It is the editor's OIDC client (src/utils/auth.js:27, with public/silent-check-sso.html (and the .js it loads) for the silent check-sso frame: init, login, logout, token refresh) and nothing else in the tree does this; it is held at 23 to match the Keycloak 23 server, and moves with the server migration to 26.
